introHtml: Custom golf divot tools with carabiner combine essential course repair with convenient clip-on portability. Whether you are outfitting a corporate tournament or rewarding top sales performers, these tools attach easily to golf bags, belt loops, or cooler straps. Choose from metal or rugged multi-tool designs, and add your logo through pad printing or laser engraving for a polished look. The carabiner ensures your brand stays visible round after round.
